l1_words.meaning: to intend or aim to do something
to watch something or to attend an event
current or present at this time
possible or occasional, happening from time to time

pattern_explanation: The Portuguese words and their English look-alikes come from the same Latin roots, so the spellings stayed close while the meanings shifted over time.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word for to intend (pretender) looks almost identical to the English verb pretend, which means to act as if something is true when it is not. A student who writes that they pretend to finish a task changes the meaning completely, so the intended meaning must be expressed with English intend or plan.
